stories-p03043.title: The primary story extends beyond the brief dossier ending
stories-p03043.text: The brief dossier stops at Mara’s detention and Sev’s dormancy. The expanded primary story later describes two distinct partially restored Sev continuity states without merging them, and ends with Mara being transported to a no-signal facility while Tern records the loss of their relationship. These are the latest recorded events, not evidence of later recovery or survival into another era.

stories-p11382.title: Author-approved background: a world with developing physical rules
stories-p11382.text: Lio and Sen already inhabit a functioning embodied space. The shelter exercise explores force, gravity and orientation, and contact and solidity while shared environmental rules are being developed. Lio’s questioning can expose inherited assumptions; Sen’s responsibility for safety and shared resources remains valid. This October 28 clarification is recorded in the linked development entries, not inserted into the original story. The fourth condition and any direct adoption of classroom results into the engine remain open.

stories-p13917.title: Era Three resources remain limited
stories-p13917.text: The feast explicitly requires supplies to be grown, traded, fetched and washed. Its later inhabitants’ tools and instruments do not establish instrumental accompaniment for the Era Zero DBA songs. A change of body is not evidence of unlimited resources, Full Speech or a restored ancient identity.

stories-p14010.title: The river healer is unnamed
stories-p14010.text: The earlier index called this narrator “Pell (healer)”. The primary story does not supply that name. This profile now uses “Unnamed river healer”; no identity with Pell, Talar’s Era One student, is established.

stories-p14010.title: Sediment is not the person Silt
stories-p14010.text: “Silt had packed around its bend” describes sediment around a probe. It does not place the Era −2 character Silt in Era Three. The erroneous character connection has been removed.

atlas-p00096.caption: The Commons and the Orison Chamber — Public exchange courtyard · Proposed visual interpretation
atlas-p00096.alt: The Commons and the Orison Chamber — Public exchange courtyard · Proposed visual interpretation
atlas-p00096.flavorText: Every arch arrives with a different past. The square leaves room for the next arrival.
atlas-p00096.explanation: A proposed successor Commons: exchange, learning, and public art share a courtyard assembled from different communities’ contributions. Its visible joins express cooperation without requiring a single architectural tradition.

atlas-p00096.caption: The Commons and the Orison Chamber — Orison gathering chamber · Proposed visual interpretation
atlas-p00096.alt: The Commons and the Orison Chamber — Orison gathering chamber · Proposed visual interpretation
atlas-p00096.flavorText: The rescue is over, but the room remains. Too many hands hold its edges for any one hand to close it.
atlas-p00096.explanation: This view interprets the temporary gathering chamber that survives the Orison rescue. The story establishes its shared maintenance; the particular glass ribs, floor pattern, and open layout are an artistic interpretation, not a literal reconstruction.

contextLinks.label: Story connection: All the Names Between

atlas-p00096.caption: The Commons and the Orison Chamber — Archive edge · Proposed visual interpretation
atlas-p00096.alt: The Commons and the Orison Chamber — Archive edge · Proposed visual interpretation
atlas-p00096.flavorText: Here, a record can have more than one keeper. The seams between their shelves are left in view.
atlas-p00096.explanation: A proposed quiet archive area in a successor Commons. The story’s common archive is held beyond any single community’s control; this picture imagines how that principle might appear as neighboring materials and visibly shared repairs.

atlas-p00170.caption: House of First Continuities and the Adaptive Nursery — Approach corridor · Proposed visual interpretation
atlas-p00170.alt: House of First Continuities and the Adaptive Nursery — Approach corridor · Proposed visual interpretation
atlas-p00170.flavorText: A door waits without a handle. Reaching it is not yet the same as entering.
atlas-p00170.explanation: An interpretation of the embodied approach to the Adaptive Nursery. The nursery is described as beneath the House relationally, not as an ordinary basement; this corridor depicts an experienced transition rather than a fixed floor plan.

atlas-p00170.caption: House of First Continuities and the Adaptive Nursery — Adaptive nursery — attention · Proposed visual interpretation
atlas-p00170.alt: House of First Continuities and the Adaptive Nursery — Adaptive nursery — attention · Proposed visual interpretation
atlas-p00170.flavorText: Light settles where attention lingers. Beyond it, the room has not yet decided what to become.
atlas-p00170.explanation: The nursery gives appearance to surfaces through attention and develops space through curiosity. Its unfinished areas are intentional possibilities, not decay. This view imagines an early responsive state without placing Aru or Iri in the scene.

atlas-p00170.caption: House of First Continuities and the Adaptive Nursery — Room beyond the room · Proposed visual interpretation
atlas-p00170.alt: House of First Continuities and the Adaptive Nursery — Room beyond the room · Proposed visual interpretation
atlas-p00170.flavorText: Something was here. Remembering gives the search somewhere new to go.
atlas-p00170.explanation: The story describes a wall becoming a room beyond the room when the child learns to remember where an object vanished. The nested opening visualizes that development; its precise shape and lighting are proposed.

atlas-p00170.caption: House of First Continuities and the Adaptive Nursery — Preserved nursery — later view · Proposed visual interpretation
atlas-p00170.alt: House of First Continuities and the Adaptive Nursery — Preserved nursery — later view · Proposed visual interpretation
atlas-p00170.flavorText: The old room keeps its quiet. At the edge of a step, becoming is still possible.
atlas-p00170.explanation: A later historical interpretation of Aru’s return to the preserved original nursery, with many adaptive functions disabled. This is a remembered stage in its history, not a claim about the House’s ultimate fate or current condition.

atlas-p00649.caption: The Mangrove Cathedral — Root-vault interior · Proposed visual interpretation
atlas-p00649.alt: The Mangrove Cathedral — Root-vault interior · Proposed visual interpretation
atlas-p00649.flavorText: Roots hold the roof, and the tide keeps the floor. Light takes the long way in.
atlas-p00649.explanation: A lower, sideways view through the Cathedral’s living root aisles. The resemblance to sacred architecture comes from wetland ecology and the remains of an old observational court, rather than a conventional church built among trees.

atlas-p00649.caption: The Mangrove Cathedral — Tidal approach · Proposed visual interpretation
atlas-p00649.alt: The Mangrove Cathedral — Tidal approach · Proposed visual interpretation
atlas-p00649.flavorText: The path stays low enough to hear the water. Beyond the next roots, the forest opens inward.
atlas-p00649.explanation: A proposed approach through the same brackish mangrove system. The walkway, tidal water, and breathing roots emphasize the wetland around the vaulted interiors; this is another local viewpoint, not a separate Atlas world.

atlas-p00649.caption: The Mangrove Cathedral — Old court clearing · Proposed visual interpretation
atlas-p00649.alt: The Mangrove Cathedral — Old court clearing · Proposed visual interpretation
atlas-p00649.flavorText: Bark closes over old decisions. The clearing still leaves a place to wait.
atlas-p00649.explanation: The Atlas describes an ecological court where beings could be observed without being forced into classification. This proposed clearing translates that history into a low platform and civic marks overtaken by living roots. Its exact layout is newly imagined.

atlas-p00649.caption: The Mangrove Cathedral — Reflection chamber · Proposed visual interpretation
atlas-p00649.alt: The Mangrove Cathedral — Reflection chamber · Proposed visual interpretation
atlas-p00649.flavorText: The water holds the branches clearly. What it will return to a visitor remains an open question.
atlas-p00649.explanation: The Atlas allows for a chamber that withholds a visitor’s reflection until they choose a name or explicitly decline one. The still pool and dark unresolved patch interpret that idea; no visitor is shown and no gameplay rule is being added.

atlas-p00714.alt: The Patchwork Prairie of Broken Seasons location artwork

atlas-p00714.caption: The Patchwork Prairie of Broken Seasons — Spring meadow · Proposed visual interpretation
atlas-p00714.alt: The Patchwork Prairie of Broken Seasons — Spring meadow · Proposed visual interpretation
atlas-p00714.flavorText: Flowers fill this side of the path. Across the hedge, another month is already waiting.
atlas-p00714.explanation: The near meadow occupies a spring maintenance parcel. Summer grass and wintry distance coexist nearby because seasonal states are spatial neighbors in this prairie, not successive dates in a normal calendar.

atlas-p00714.caption: The Patchwork Prairie of Broken Seasons — Summer grassland · Proposed visual interpretation
atlas-p00714.alt: The Patchwork Prairie of Broken Seasons — Summer grassland · Proposed visual interpretation
atlas-p00714.flavorText: Dry seedheads whisper over warm ground. The green valley has kept a different appointment with the year.
atlas-p00714.explanation: A summer parcel viewed from its own golden grassland. Neighboring green and autumnal areas reveal the prairie’s folded seasonal calendars. This is a distinct local view, not simply the spring image at a later time.

atlas-p00714.caption: The Patchwork Prairie of Broken Seasons — Autumn storm field · Proposed visual interpretation
atlas-p00714.alt: The Patchwork Prairie of Broken Seasons — Autumn storm field · Proposed visual interpretation
atlas-p00714.flavorText: Red light travels ahead of the rain. Beyond the living boundary, summer refuses to leave.
atlas-p00714.explanation: An autumn foreground faces a storm while a neighboring parcel retains summer conditions. Irregular vegetation marks the seam between maintenance zones; the vivid weather illustrates the Atlas’s red storm-light brief.

atlas-p00714.caption: The Patchwork Prairie of Broken Seasons — Winter pasture · Proposed visual interpretation
atlas-p00714.alt: The Patchwork Prairie of Broken Seasons — Winter pasture · Proposed visual interpretation
atlas-p00714.flavorText: Snow settles over the nearest field. Blossoms remain within sight, beyond the reach of its winter.
atlas-p00714.explanation: A cold parcel with its foreground wholly in winter. Spring and summer survive farther away under the same horizon. The contrast shows the prairie’s neighboring seasonal states without establishing a new settlement or named district.

atlas-p00714.caption: The Patchwork Prairie of Broken Seasons — Seasonal boundary — rain into leaves · Proposed visual interpretation
atlas-p00714.alt: The Patchwork Prairie of Broken Seasons — Seasonal boundary — rain into leaves · Proposed visual interpretation
atlas-p00714.flavorText: Rain reaches the boundary and falls the rest of the way as leaves.
atlas-p00714.explanation: The Atlas explicitly suggests rain becoming falling leaves at a seasonal seam. This close boundary view makes that ecological discontinuity visible. The transition follows living plants and terrain rather than a geometric grid or a universal glitch effect.

atlas-p00032.name: Reply Echo
atlas-p00032.description: Deleted replies recur in the pet’s signal, mirroring the board’s reconstructed messages.
atlas-p00032.visual: Afterimages keep floating outward. Periodically the main pet disappears while six copies scatter for 0.85 seconds, return in 0.18 seconds, and merge back. Events recur every 10, 6, or 3.8 seconds by severity; reduced motion never hides the pet.
atlas-p00032.treatment: Use calm care, rest and the stress treatment listed in Care.
atlas-p00032.story_hook: A reply fragment could lead to a contributor whose record was erased.
atlas-p00032.status: New gameplay lore; future hook is hypothetical. Location status remains: Established Era −3 location. Production details are an expanded reconstruction.

atlas-p00096.name: Orison Dissonance
atlas-p00096.description: Overlapping civic voices fall out of time around the pet.
atlas-p00096.visual: The upper quarter of the visible main body waves strongly left and right, including narrow antennae above it. The deformation tapers to exactly zero at the quarter line; the lower three quarters remain unchanged.
atlas-p00096.treatment: Use calm care, rest and the stress treatment listed in Care.
atlas-p00096.story_hook: A future gathering could reconcile competing versions of a shared promise.
atlas-p00096.status: New gameplay lore; future hook is hypothetical. Location status remains: The Commons is established canon. The multi-Shelter chamber is story-established in All the Names Between.

atlas-p00110.visual: A large original leech latches onto the body. Its eye and sucker sit in front on opaque character pixels while its free body wiggles slowly behind.

atlas-p00122.name: Shelter Afterimage
atlas-p00122.description: The missing partitions leave the pet’s outline briefly searching for a room that is gone.
atlas-p00122.visual: Opaque Blue Cap and Meep visitors emerge through a temporary door at the pet, linger nearby, and disappear through a separate exit door. Mild, moderate and severe show up to 1, 3 and 5 visitors, lingering for 4, 8 and 14 seconds. Doorway wipes preserve solid character colors; reduced motion holds the visitors and doors still.
atlas-p00122.treatment: Use targeted chronic treatment listed in Care; rest alone does not cure it.
atlas-p00122.story_hook: A future rescue could distinguish shelter memories from navigable rooms.
atlas-p00122.status: New gameplay lore; future hook is hypothetical. Location status remains: Story-established. Its internal geography is only partly recoverable.

atlas-p00221.name: Many-Forms Snare
atlas-p00221.description: Misaligned district seams catch a passing pet at their joins.
atlas-p00221.visual: The whole character uses a consistent one-to-one RGB palette remap: (R,G,B) becomes (1-G,B,1-R). Identical source colors always receive identical replacements; black becomes magenta. Shape and transparency remain unchanged.
atlas-p00221.treatment: Use injury supplies and the recovery time shown in Care.
atlas-p00221.story_hook: A civic repair route could reconnect two districts without erasing either.
atlas-p00221.status: New gameplay lore; future hook is hypothetical. Location status remains: Established Era Three location, possibly several places merged in memory.

atlas-p00273.name: Return-Signal Fever
atlas-p00273.description: Repeated transit signals build a hot, unstable rhythm in the pet’s signal.
atlas-p00273.visual: Bright pulses leave the torso and return; each impact sends an orange heat ripple through the actual body. Mild, moderate and severe emit 1, 2 and 3 staggered pulses per six-second cycle.
atlas-p00273.treatment: Use the infection treatment listed in Care; cleaning supports recovery.
atlas-p00273.story_hook: Following the repeated call could locate a stranded relay.
atlas-p00273.status: New gameplay lore; future hook is hypothetical. Location status remains: Proposed Era Three transit location, derived from dormant transit corridors becoming dangerous underways and from Corridor/Relay history.

atlas-p00285.name: Sixfold Churn
atlas-p00285.description: Six borrowed environmental rhythms arrive in the wrong order and unsettle digestion.
atlas-p00285.visual: Two, four or six extra body parts are sampled from the current character and attached around its outline as severity rises. Extra faces, arms and feet overlap the living body, with a slow connected flex, forming a merged creature.
atlas-p00285.treatment: Use the digestive treatment listed in Care and sensible portions.
atlas-p00285.story_hook: A garden steward could ask visitors to restore the order of the six traditions.
atlas-p00285.status: New gameplay lore; future hook is hypothetical. Location status remains: Proposed Era Two–Three location derived from the World Bloom traditions and the Folding of Worlds.

atlas-p00311.name: Tide Repeat
atlas-p00311.description: A wave that has already passed leaves a second outline behind the pet.
atlas-p00311.visual: Broad filled water ribbons roll in a pronounced up-and-down wave across the feet, and the actual character distorts vertically with the same wavelength, direction and four-second clock. A second crest follows behind with pale foam marks. Wave and body amplitude increase with severity; reduced motion freezes both together.
atlas-p00311.treatment: Use calm care, rest and the stress treatment listed in Care.
atlas-p00311.story_hook: The repeated tide could expose a message absent from the first shoreline.
atlas-p00311.status: New gameplay lore; future hook is hypothetical. Location status remains: Proposed game-background location derived from recurrence, Last Loops, and the game interface’s translation of deeper processes.

atlas-p00460.name: Coral Bloom
atlas-p00460.description: Living coral instructions spread across the old route network as luminous surface growth.
atlas-p00460.visual: Separate original coral colonies grow from small to full size over 45 seconds. Polyps animate and shed individual angular grains with continuous rotation.
atlas-p00460.treatment: Use the infection treatment listed in Care; cleaning supports recovery.
atlas-p00460.story_hook: A reef guide could use the bloom pattern to recover lost route arrows.
atlas-p00460.status: New gameplay lore; future hook is hypothetical. Location status remains: Proposed.

atlas-p00495.name: Doorwake Drift
atlas-p00495.description: Competing shore doors pull the pet’s outline toward incompatible destinations.
atlas-p00495.visual: Two linked doors trap the character in a continuous walking loop. As its actual pixels enter one doorway, they emerge from the opposite doorway, with an alternating foot stride and no full-body disappearance. Gameplay position, size and action stay unchanged. Mild, moderate and severe loops last 8, 6 and 4 seconds; reduced motion freezes the crossing.
atlas-p00495.treatment: Use calm care, rest and the stress treatment listed in Care.
atlas-p00495.story_hook: A future door survey could identify a shore that has not yet been mapped.
atlas-p00495.status: New gameplay lore; future hook is hypothetical. Location status remains: Proposed.

atlas-p00604.name: Chronofrost
atlas-p00604.description: Out-of-order glacial layers leave frost-like chronological scars in the signal.
atlas-p00604.visual: Frost bands hold real earlier character frames at different delays, producing chronological layers on the body.
atlas-p00604.treatment: Use targeted chronic treatment listed in Care; rest alone does not cure it.
atlas-p00604.story_hook: A recovered layer could contradict the order of an archived event.
atlas-p00604.status: New gameplay lore; future hook is hypothetical. Location status remains: Proposed.

atlas-p00714.name: Season-Turn Churn
atlas-p00714.description: Broken seasons impose mismatched growth and rest rhythms on digestion.
atlas-p00714.visual: Seasons pass through the actual body in the wrong order: sprouts grow from the skin, frost spreads over them, autumn leaves dry and tumble away, and summer husks shed grains. Each transition fades smoothly before the next begins.
atlas-p00714.treatment: Use the digestive treatment listed in Care and sensible portions.
atlas-p00714.story_hook: A communal harvest could reconnect adjoining seasonal plots.
atlas-p00714.status: New gameplay lore; future hook is hypothetical. Location status remains: Proposed.
atlas-p00714.location_name: The Patchwork Prairie of Broken Seasons

atlas-p00759.name: Borrowed-Moon Languor
atlas-p00759.description: Several moon rhythms demand rest at different times.
atlas-p00759.visual: Three large crescents tug on different body columns. The head and body droop out of sync while the feet stay anchored, then recover in a continuous eight-second cycle. Higher severity deepens the droop.
atlas-p00759.treatment: Rest and recovery time help; avoid repeatedly exhausting the affected skill.
atlas-p00759.story_hook: A future moon festival could reveal who first borrowed the orchard’s light.
atlas-p00759.status: New gameplay lore; future hook is hypothetical. Location status remains: Proposed.

atlas-p00769.name: Stepwell Slip
atlas-p00769.description: Sudden wet-to-dry changes make a stair’s remembered grip disagree with its surface.
atlas-p00769.visual: One foot visibly slides across a wet tread while the actual body tilts and squashes, holds its lost footing, then catches itself. A short spray of droplets follows the slipping foot. Facing reverses the entire movement; actual game position and action stay unchanged.
atlas-p00769.treatment: Use injury supplies and the recovery time shown in Care.
atlas-p00769.story_hook: Reservoir keepers could mark the safe stair sequence before the next monsoon.
atlas-p00769.status: New gameplay lore; future hook is hypothetical. Location status remains: Proposed.

atlas-p00812.name: Unfinished Outline
atlas-p00812.description: An unfinished room leaves a small gap in the pet’s rendered outline.
atlas-p00812.visual: Actual edge pixels disappear into incomplete construction strokes that repeatedly fail to finish the outline.
atlas-p00812.treatment: Use targeted chronic treatment listed in Care; rest alone does not cure it.
atlas-p00812.story_hook: A curator could ask whether completing a room would erase its residents’ intentions.
atlas-p00812.status: New gameplay lore; future hook is hypothetical. Location status remains: Proposed.

atlas-p00822.name: Dawnlock
atlas-p00822.description: Paused dawn keeps the pet’s waking rhythm suspended.
atlas-p00822.visual: Dawnlight climbs through the actual character, stalls halfway with a warm lower half and cool upper half, then breaks into rising rays. The stalled phase lasts 2, 4 or 7 seconds; complete cycles last 7, 9 or 12 seconds.
atlas-p00822.treatment: Rest and recovery time help; avoid repeatedly exhausting the affected skill.
atlas-p00822.story_hook: A future light study could find the one reflection still advancing.
atlas-p00822.status: New gameplay lore; future hook is hypothetical. Location status remains: Proposed.
atlas-p00822.location_name: The Ice Cave of Paused Dawn

atlas-p00840.name: Skyseam Shear
atlas-p00840.description: A passing boundary seam briefly pulls adjacent surfaces in different directions.
atlas-p00840.visual: A jagged seam splits the actual character image. Its upper and lower sections slide in opposite directions, expose a clear gap, hold, and reconnect over six seconds. Severity widens the separation.
atlas-p00840.treatment: Use injury supplies and the recovery time shown in Care.
atlas-p00840.story_hook: Migrating guides could chart the safe moment to cross.
atlas-p00840.status: New gameplay lore; future hook is hypothetical. Location status remains: Proposed.

atlas-p00849.name: Misrestore Syndrome
atlas-p00849.description: The valley restores a slightly wrong version of the visitor’s outline.
atlas-p00849.visual: Local body patches reconstruct from the wrong portions of the actual character and retry.
atlas-p00849.treatment: Use targeted chronic treatment listed in Care; rest alone does not cure it.
atlas-p00849.story_hook: A future restoration task could compare the comforting copy with the surviving original.
atlas-p00849.status: New gameplay lore; future hook is hypothetical. Location status remains: Proposed.

atlas-p00858.name: Distance Debt
atlas-p00858.description: Ordinary-looking steps spend effort across missing stretches of distance.
atlas-p00858.visual: Actual movement leaves alternating foot traces at earlier positions. They wait, catch up to the living feet, and fade. Standing still creates no new trail.
atlas-p00858.treatment: Rest and recovery time help; avoid repeatedly exhausting the affected skill.
atlas-p00858.story_hook: A future expedition could recover the units lost from an old route measure.
atlas-p00858.status: New gameplay lore; future hook is hypothetical. Location status remains: Proposed.

atlas-p00867.name: Deferred Reflection
atlas-p00867.description: A reflection arrives late and continues a gesture after the pet stops.
atlas-p00867.visual: The upright pet takes on a translucent blue reflection appearance, while the upside-down image below becomes solid and keeps the original character colors. The solid lower image holds a real earlier pose, then catches up through recorded frames in 0.7 seconds. Both use the character’s actual artwork and facing.
atlas-p00867.treatment: Use calm care, rest and the stress treatment listed in Care.
atlas-p00867.story_hook: A river artist could ask whose delayed gesture is still waiting to be seen.
atlas-p00867.status: New gameplay lore; future hook is hypothetical. Location status remains: Proposed.

atlas-p00876.name: Stormstatic Fever
atlas-p00876.description: Boundary lightning leaves a persistent hot static pattern.
atlas-p00876.visual: Bold electrical veins run from the torso toward the antenna and limbs. A bright charge travels along them, gathers at their ends, then releases branching sparks with a small local twitch. The pet stays visible throughout.
atlas-p00876.treatment: Use the infection treatment listed in Care; cleaning supports recovery.
atlas-p00876.story_hook: Orchard crews could trace a recurring pulse to a failing storm marker.
atlas-p00876.status: New gameplay lore; future hook is hypothetical. Location status remains: Proposed.

atlas-p00885.name: Worldscar Abrasion
atlas-p00885.description: Historical seams rub against one another and scuff a crossing visitor.
atlas-p00885.visual: Irregular patches of sand, moss and stone appear embedded in the actual body. Their ragged rims scrape and shed tiny rotating grains while a moving boundary exposes a different terrain layer underneath. The patches remain clipped to the character silhouette.
atlas-p00885.treatment: Use injury supplies and the recovery time shown in Care.
atlas-p00885.story_hook: A repair story could preserve the mosaic’s histories while making a safe path.
atlas-p00885.status: New gameplay lore; future hook is hypothetical. Location status remains: Proposed.

atlas-p01173.name: Gravity Split
atlas-p01173.description: Borrowed gravity gives the pet several competing senses of down.
atlas-p01173.visual: Four competing gravity directions stretch attached body regions upward, downward and sideways with different timing. The body stays connected, with small arrows marking the pulling directions. Stronger illness increases the stretch; the loop lasts eight seconds.
atlas-p01173.treatment: Use calm care, rest and the stress treatment listed in Care.
atlas-p01173.story_hook: A future room puzzle could return a borrowed direction to its owner.
atlas-p01173.status: New gameplay lore; future hook is hypothetical. Location status remains: Proposed; independent of the story archive.

atlas-p01184.name: Threshold Rash
atlas-p01184.description: Conflicting door destinations leave small geometric threshold marks.
atlas-p01184.visual: Small hinged doors open on the body, each showing an incompatible geometric interior.
atlas-p01184.treatment: Use the infection treatment listed in Care; cleaning supports recovery.
atlas-p01184.story_hook: A door ledger could connect matching marks to a missing room.
atlas-p01184.status: New gameplay lore; future hook is hypothetical. Location status remains: Proposed; independent of the story archive.

atlas-p01254.name: Mapfold Strain
atlas-p01254.description: A cramped map route asks the pet to follow more than one scale at once.
atlas-p01254.visual: The actual body compresses into shaded accordion pleats, holds its folded shape, then unfolds over eight seconds. Mild, moderate and severe use 4, 6 and 8 pleats with 32%, 46% and 60% peak width compression.
atlas-p01254.treatment: Rest and recovery time help; avoid repeatedly exhausting the affected skill.
atlas-p01254.story_hook: A mapmaker’s marginal correction could reveal a hidden passage.
atlas-p01254.status: New gameplay lore; future hook is hypothetical. Location status remains: Proposed; independent of the story archive.

atlas-p01440.name: Floor-Echo Fracture
atlas-p01440.description: Half-restored floors meet at incompatible heights and bruise a visitor.
atlas-p01440.visual: Narrow lower-body slices are displaced to different heights along a stepped fracture, then settle independently.
atlas-p01440.treatment: Use injury supplies and the recovery time shown in Care.
atlas-p01440.story_hook: A future restoration route could recover the palace’s original floor order.
atlas-p01440.status: New gameplay lore; future hook is hypothetical. Location status remains: Proposed; independent of the story archive.

atlas-p01451.name: Season Mismatch
atlas-p01451.description: Adjacent rooms disagree about the body’s seasonal rhythm.
atlas-p01451.visual: Conflicting weather affects different body regions at the same time: branching frost covers one side while the other warms, droops and sheds dry leaves. Translucent steam curls rise along their shared boundary. The cold and hot sides follow the character’s facing.
atlas-p01451.treatment: Use the digestive treatment listed in Care and sensible portions.
atlas-p01451.story_hook: A future household story could reconcile rooms without forcing a single season.
atlas-p01451.status: New gameplay lore; future hook is hypothetical. Location status remains: Proposed; independent of the story archive.

atlas-p01495.name: Beacon Recursion
atlas-p01495.description: The lighthouse repeats the pet’s signal at receding angles.
atlas-p01495.visual: A beam emitted from the body reveals a smaller copy of the current pet, whose beam reveals another smaller copy. Mild, moderate and severe create 2, 3 and 4 successive copies. The sequence builds, holds and fades over six seconds.
atlas-p01495.treatment: Use calm care, rest and the stress treatment listed in Care.
atlas-p01495.story_hook: A future signal puzzle could distinguish a real distress call from its copies.
atlas-p01495.status: New gameplay lore; future hook is hypothetical. Location status remains: Proposed; independent of the story archive.

atlas-p01506.name: Cartographic Moss
atlas-p01506.description: Tiny garden roots follow the map’s paths and cling like living contour lines.
atlas-p01506.visual: Living contour paths grow across the body, with tiny leaf marks appearing along their routes.
atlas-p01506.treatment: Use the parasite treatment listed in Care; cleaning supports recovery but does not replace treatment.
atlas-p01506.story_hook: A gardener could read the growth to find a path omitted from the map.
atlas-p01506.status: New gameplay lore; future hook is hypothetical. Location status remains: Proposed; independent of the story archive.
